description: Deployment with no securityContext at all -- the PugetScope shape
note: The case the volume decision came from: one missing block raises eleven labelled pairs across both tools, and one securityContext fix clears all of them at once. Every other case here isolates a single rule; this one exists to keep the collapse measurable. Deliberately labelled with the whole family rather than a minimum -- see multi-iac-spec §5.1.
